title: Battle of Tarnab (1448)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Tarnab (1448)", at revision 1376545633, opens: "The Battle of Tarnab took place in 1448." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4872511, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1448 battle of the TImurid Civil Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
